ch.zizka.luanti.mods.m16b:m16b_creaturesworld 35289 发布, Add creatures and capture balls.

This mod add some creatures and some capture balls for caprute them!                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            
Is in WIP, but i don't think it can brake your world :D                                                                                                                                                        
But the items and the creature this mod add can be removed or changed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
For this reason, in future updates, your capture ball or your favorite creature can disappear.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
For now the mod add:                                                                                                                                                        
Three evolution lines: earth, water and fire;                                                                                                                                                        
2 capture balls: CaptureBall and the God CaptureBall;                                                                                                                                                        
and the XP system (is WIP), because for now you need to sneak+right click on the creature to upgrade is level.                                                                                                                                                       
P.S.: The creature are static because I don't know how to animate they.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
notes: AI was mainly used to create the names of the creatures.

ch.zizka.luanti.mods.awuuwa:default_textures_for_other_games 30592 发布, mods that only depend on Minetest Game's "default" for textures, can use this mod in other games in the Luanti engine

Mods that use "default" textures from Minetest Game, can use this mod instead to supply themselves with textures, in other games for the Luanti game engine. Using this mod assumes you are not using Minetest Game, do not use this mod with Minetest Game, as this mod serves no purpose for you there. This mod adds the "default" textures to be used in other games for the Luanti engine outside of Minetest Game

Credits to respective authors and copyright information is contained in the file "License.txt" in the downloaded package.

Note: Since there is no meaningful source code used in this mod, the init.lua file is only there because it is required for the game engine to register this as a mod, the mod is marked as being licensed under "0BSD" in the Luanti ContentDB just to indicate that some license is used. Since the question of what license is used is not really applicable, using 0BSD should at least not cause any unnecessary restrictions.

ch.zizka.luanti.mods.m16b:m16b_mystic_stones 39547 发布, Add many items, mobs and blocks. Wiki: https://wiki.kaarum.com

- OFFICIAL WIKI: https://wiki.kaarum.com
- OFFICIAL DISCORD SERVER: https://discord.gg/WDgzGDmEh

Mystic Stones – Transform Your Mineclonia World!

Welcome to Mystic Stones, the mod that will revolutionize the way you play Mineclonia! If you’re a fan of exploration, magic, and challenges, this mod is perfect for you. Discover a new world where Mystic Stones allow you to craft extraordinary items, unlock mysteries, and embark on exciting adventures. Here’s what you can expect:

- Transform and Craft: Use the Mystic Stones to transform common items into special ones and create powerful swords, armor, and tools! Want a unique weapon or a rare mineral? The possibilities are endless!

- Mob Spawn Eggs: For the first time in Mineclonia, you will have the power to create mob spawn eggs! Control your world like never before, summon creatures, and explore new gameplay opportunities.

- New Structures and Monster Bosses: Explore mysterious new structures scattered across the world, each with a story to uncover! Face the new monster introduced by the mod and prepare for even greater challenges!

- A Living World with Lore: Encounter written books that will reveal the mystery behind these new structures and creatures. Every corner hides a story, a clue, a secret waiting to be discovered.

- Quests and Rewards: Complete main and side quests to earn special armor, rare minerals, and unique resources. Every quest is an opportunity to upgrade your character and make your world even more extraordinary.

Installing Mystic Stones means diving into a new experience, full of discoveries and adventures! Don’t wait any longer: transform your Mineclonia world into a magical place, full of mysteries to unravel and powers to conquer!

# mcl_rocky_tools

- License: BSD 3-clause
- Image license: CC-by-4.0
- Depends: mcl_tools, mcl_farming, mcl_deepslate
- Version: 1.0

A few extra recipes for creating tools from alternate rock types:
Granite, Andesite, Diorite, and Deepslate. The goal is to make finding
them a bit more exciting, although YMMV depending on which kinds of
pickaxes you like to mine with. The resulting tools are better than base
cobblestone variants, but not as good as iron, and of course, they aren't
more powerful than cobblestone in terms of what they can mine. Relative
to base cobblestone tools, these tools have the following differences:

- Andesite: slightly higher durability; slightly longer reach
- Diorite: slightly higher durability; slightly faster swing
- Granite: somewhat higher durability
- Deepslate: much higher durability; slightly faster swing
# Credits

- I started this by cloning [the mcl_multitool mod by
  DUCKGO](https://codeberg.org/duckgo/mcl_multitool/src/branch/main).
  I've rewritten the code, but leaned on the original as my example to
  work from.
- Textures are re-colored from the Mineclone 2 defaults, which are from
  [the Pixel Perfection texture pack by
  XSSheep](https://www.planetminecraft.com/texture-pack/131pixel-perfection/)
  which is licensed under the [Creative Commons Attribution-Share Alike
  4.0 International
  License](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). These
  textures themselves are re-licensed under the same license.

ch.zizka.luanti.mods.daenvil:vegan_food 32162 发布, Adds plant-based foods such as plant milk, tofu, seitan, etc.

A Luanti mod that adds a variety of plant-based foods such as plant milk, tofu, seitan, etc. Compatible with Minetest- and MineClone-based games (such as VoxeLibre or Mesecraft).

## Features

Adds the following items:

- **Plant milk bucket**: works the same as a cow milk bucket. Made in a crafting table with a water bucket and 6 seeds/wheat/potatoes/beans/etc. (acceptable items depend on the game and mods installed, for VoxeLibre/Mineclonia they are: any seeds, wheat, potatoes, or sunflowers).
- **Tofu**: food item made by cooking plant milk in a furnace.
- **Not-fish fillet** (raw and cooked): a food item similar to fish, made by combining tofu with kelp. Can be cooked in a furnace.
- **Seitan** (raw and cooked): a food item similar to beef, made by combining 3 wheat with any vegetable soup or stew (for VoxeLibre/Mineclonia: beetroot soup or mushroom stew). Can be cooked in a furnace.
- **Apple and flower syrups** (only if a game/mod with honey is installed): food items similar to honey. Apple syrup is made by combining an apple with an empty bottle, and flower syrup is made by combining 6 flowers with a water bottle.

For Mineclonia and VoxeLibre only:

- **Cakes** can be crafted substituting the egg with sugar
- **Pumpkin pies** can be crafted substituting the egg with wheat
- **Seitan stew**: a food item similar to rabbit stew, made by crafting together a bowl, a cooked seitan steak, a baked potato, and a carrot.

For VoxeLibre only: **hamburgers** can be crafted with seitan, tofu, or beetroots and mushrooms.

All new recipes are meant to be alternatives for already existing animal-based foods. If you think there are missing foods or recipes please make a suggestion.

## Compatibility

This mod should be compatible with any of the most popular Minecraft-like Luanti games, like VoxeLibre, Mesecraft, Mineclonia, or Minetest. However, it's mainly designed around VoxeLibre/Mineclonia, so there could be some oversights with other games. Don't hesitate to report any such problems.

I didn't pay much attention to compatibility with other mods for now, so if there's a particular mod that doesn't match well with this one and you'd like it to be compatible, please suggest it.

ch.zizka.luanti.mods.awuuwa:oak_tree 36788 发布, oak tree resource

This mod does not make oak trees naturally generate in the world. This mod is intended to be used as a dependency for other mods to implement biomes and other world generation features to allow the spawning of oak trees naturally in the world. This mod adds the oak tree resource to a Luanti game. This mod is primarily targeting Minetest Game, to add an oak tree to it, but this works just as well with any other games. This mod has been intentionally designed in such a way where if it detects that "mcl_trees" is present, that is, if you are playing Mineclonia or any of the forks, this mod will not add the oak tree nodes, instead this mod will add aliases so that the other mods using this mod as a dependency, will now point to the "mcl_trees" oak tree instead. Which means this mod is intended to allow for interoperability of mods between games, so it will behave differently in Mineclonia / VoxeLibre and their forks, than in other games such as Minetest Game.

Included are a basic schematic for an oak tree, oak tree trunk, oak tree wooden planks, oak tree leaves, an acorn, and a sapling that is hidden from the creative menu which only spawns after planting an acorn onto soil. Note that the node that the sapling resides on, has to be in the "soil" group, so if the game you are playing in the Luanti engine does not by default have a node in the "soil" group, a third party mod needs to be added to add nodes to the "soil" group.

How this works, the included oak tree schematic has the oak trees have acorns hanging from them, the acorn can be mined and placed onto a node that is in a group "soil", then once every 20 seconds there is a 1 / 2 chance that the acorn will turn into a sapling. Once the sapling appears, in some time the tree will grow.

When used in Mineclonia / VoxeLibre and their forks, the only new node this mod adds is the acorn. This mod will also overwrite the item drop, of the existing "mcl_trees" oak tree leaves, such that when mined it will occasionally drop an acorn, and will not drop an oak sapling anymore when mined.

This mod is a work in progress, in it's current state things are not yet quite finished, and there are some known issues, including when a sapling grows, it cuts out a rectangular hole around it. This means you have to be very careful not to spawn any oak trees near buildings. There are plans to fix such issues in future releases of this mod. The textures have been designed as temporary, and thus are not necessarily the highest quality as of now, they may be changed in future releases.

Plans for the future, additional optional aliases in the settings may be introduced, such that this mod will point to other possible oak trees added by other mods much like with "mcl_trees", an example of this could be the "ebiomes" called "Extra Biomes" mod that adds an oak tree. It could be made so, that some setting could be enabled or disabled to allow for creating an alias in place of registering actual nodes, to point to that oak tree from the mentioned mod. Such things may be done in the future.

This mod adds the oak tree resource to a Luanti game. This mod is primarily targeting Minetest Game, to add an oak tree to it, but this works just as well with any other games. This mod has been intentionally designed in such a way where if it detects that "mcl_trees" is present, that is, if you are playing Mineclonia or any of the forks, this mod will not add the oak tree nodes, instead this mod will add aliases so that the other mods using this mod as a dependency, will now point to the "mcl_trees" oak tree instead. Which means this mod is intended to allow for interoperability of mods between games, so it will behave differently in Mineclonia / VoxeLibre and their forks, than in other games such as Minetest Game.

Included are a basic schematic for an oak tree, oak tree trunk, oak tree wooden planks, oak tree leaves, an acorn, and a sapling that is hidden from the creative menu which only spawns after planting an acorn onto soil. Note that the node that the sapling resides on, has to be in the "soil" group, so if the game you are playing in the Luanti engine does not by default have a node in the "soil" group, a third party mod needs to be added to add nodes to the "soil" group.

How this works, the included oak tree schematic has the oak trees have acorns hanging from them, the acorn can be mined and placed onto a node that is in a group "soil", then once every 20 seconds there is a 1 / 2 chance that the acorn will turn into a sapling. Once the sapling appears, in some time the tree will grow.

When used in Mineclonia / VoxeLibre and their forks, the only new node this mod adds is the acorn. This mod will also overwrite the item drop, of the existing "mcl_trees" oak tree leaves, such that when mined it will occasionally drop an acorn, and will not drop an oak sapling anymore when mined.

This mod is a work in progress, in it's current state things are not yet quite finished, and there are some known issues, including when a sapling grows, it cuts out a rectangular hole around it. This means you have to be very careful not to spawn any oak trees near buildings. There are plans to fix such issues in future releases of this mod. The textures have been designed as temporary, and thus are not necessarily the highest quality as of now, they may be changed in future releases.

Plans for the future, additional optional aliases in the settings may be introduced, such that this mod will point to other possible oak trees added by other mods much like with "mcl_trees", an example of this could be the "ebiomes" called "Extra Biomes" mod that adds an oak tree. It could be made so, that some setting could be enabled or disabled to allow for creating an alias in place of registering actual nodes, to point to that oak tree from the mentioned mod. Such things may be done in the future.

ch.zizka.luanti.mods.SFENCE:composting 31298.1 发布, Compost and composter machines. Mix dirt with compost to get garden soil. Plants from farming/farming redo/hades_extrafarming grows faster on garden soil. Hades Revisited is supported.

Composter allows you to compost leaves, needles, saplings, grass and some other items.

Composting speed depends on composter fill and C:N ratio. Composter should be placed on soil, to work faster.

You can craft garden soil from dirt and compost lumps. Some plants (from mod farming, [Farming Redo](https://content.luanti.org/packages/TenPlus1/farming/) and hades_extrafarming) grows faster on garden soil.

The electric composter can be powered by power generators, technic, elepower, techage or factory electric (require appliances).

See settingtypes.txt for check configuration posibilities.

ch.zizka.luanti.mods.SilverSandstone:deepslate 17511 发布, Adds deepslate and related building materials.

Deepslate
=========

This mod adds deepslate and related building materials.

Deepslate is a type of stone that can be found deep underground.
It can be crafted into bricks, blocks, tiles, and pillars for building, or
used in place of stone when crafting tools.

Ores and dungeons in the deepslate layer will generate as deepslate variants.

By default, deepslate starts generating below -768, and replaces all stone
below -1024. This can be changed in the settings.


Contents
--------

- Deepslate
- Cobbled Deepslate
- Deepslate Brick
- Cracked Deepslate Brick
- Deepslate Block (Polished Deepslate in MineClone)
- Chiselled Deepslate
- Deepslate Tiles
- Cracked Deepslate Tiles
- Deepslate Pillar
- Deepslate variants of ores


Compatible Games and Mods
-------------------------

Games:

- Minetest Game and derivatives (Dreambuilder, Mesecraft, VoxelGarden, Survivetest, etc.)
- MineClone (integrates into mcl_deepslate, providing only additional features.)
- Repixture

Ores from these mods:

- Blox
- Ethereal
- Glooptest
- Lapis Lazuli
- Legendary Ore
- Magic Materials
- More Ores
- Quartz
- Rainbow Ore
- Silver
- Technic
- Techage
- Titanium
- Zinc

Shapes and variants from these mods:

- Advanced Trains
- Castle Masonry
- Rocks
- Stairs+ (More Blocks)
- Stairs Redo

This adds a new tier of tools and armor, as well as some decorative blocks.Like gold but last longer and in pink! Rose Gold Ore is made with one copper ore, two gold ore, one blaze powder , and one nether quartz crystal in a 3x3 crafting grid. It can then be smelted into ingots.

Rose Gold tier tools have similar properties to regular gold in speed and enchantability but signifigantly more durability around that of iron. It uses some nether crafting components to balance it as a later-game material that improves on regular golds main weakness of poor durability.

Rose Gold Blocks oxidize like their copper counterpart turning from pinkish gold to blue and purple.

Rose gold lanterns and chains can also be made for lighting and decoration.

ch.zizka.luanti.mods.Liil:naturalbiomes 17269.1 发布, Adds 9 new biomes

Note: For a working leaf decay (Disappearing of leaves after a trees trunk is chopped) I recommend to use this mod: https://content.luanti.org/packages/Liil/winuserleafdecay/

This mod adds 9 new biomes to your Minetest world:

* Wet Savanna
* Outback
* Alder Swamp
* Alpine
* Beach
* Bamboo Forest
* Mediterranean
* Heath
* Bushland

It is designed for people who like survival gameplay and gives you the ability to craft new slabs, stairs and walls from the biomes plants and rocks, also a few new foods.

* Update V1.1 - Should fix the errors with biome generation, saplings and tree growth
* Update V1.2 - Missing recipes for walls added
* Update V1.3 - Added Ethereal support/compatibility
* Update V1.4 - Added the correct growth position of trees from saplings without deleting surrounding nodes. It also includes some little fixes, a new alpine biome cowberry bush and minimal texture changes.
* Update V1.4 - Added heath biome, some more precise tree descriptions/names
* Update V1.42 - Should fix the leaf decay problem thanks to the help of ShadMOrdre
* Update V1.43 - Fixed cowberries and added dye crafting from flowers
* Update V1.45 - Adds Bushland Biome
* Update V1.47 - Adds doors and trapdoors

ch.zizka.luanti.mods._Krush:kodama_companion 36706 发布, A Kodama spirit that follows you and warns you of nearby enemies.

**Kodama Companion**

*! Summon Song Update !*

Plant trees so Kodama will help you! The trees are our friends <3
Once you have earned a Kodama, you can also summon it by playing C - E - G on the recorder. This requires the Recorder mod
(https://content.luanti.org/packages/_Krush/recorder/) and is optional.

Features:

- Smooth orbiting movement — gentle, natural hovering
- Look-at reaction — Kodama notices when you gaze at it, drifts closer, and responds with a sound
- Hostile mob detection — Kodama glows and alerts you to danger
- Happiness mechanic — needs petting every 60 seconds (visual + sound only — no speed penalty)
- Recorder integration — play C - E - G on the recorder to summon your Kodama
- 6 Color Variants — Blue, Green, Gold, Purple, Red, and Default
- Custom sounds — summon song, look-at reaction, sleep sound, and more
- Glows in the dark
- Custom particle effects (happy, sad, alert, magic, summon, sleep)
- Persistent storage — your bond AND color choice survive server restarts
- Leaves with a sad little tap if neglected for 150 seconds


| Command | Description |

/kodama_call | Summon your Kodama companion (if you have earned one) |

/kodama_leave | Dismiss your Kodama|

/kodama_time | Check how long since you last pet your Kodama |

/kodama_status | Check Kodama and current color |


Color-Commands:

- /kodama_blue
- /kodama_green
- /kodama_gold
- /kodama_purple
- /kodama_red
- /kodama_default

Power generators
==============

This mod add liquid fuel powered generators into minetest worlds.
Shaft electric engines is alse added, and can be powered from included electric generators or from technic electric sources.
Generatos supports Minetest default game and Hades Revisited.

Generators are powered by appliances mod API. So, on appliances APi based machines can easy access the power from generator.

To get fuel, use biofuel mod.

The electric engines and rmp_meter can be powered by power generators, technic, elepower, techage or factory electric.

ch.zizka.luanti.mods.SFENCE:hades_extensionmods 31301.1 发布, Pack of mods for subgame Hades Revisited.

[Shared forum topic](https://forum.minetest.net/viewtopic.php?t=26747)

Modpack of some mods with non-GPL license modified for subgame [Hades Revisited.](https://content.luanti.org/packages/Wuzzy/hades_revisited/). Check mods in pack for license.
Included:

* hades_default -> Some function from origin Minetest game default mod, required for easier porting of mods for [Hades Revisited.](https://content.luanti.org/packages/Wuzzy/hades_revisited/) subgame.
* hades_bucket -> Like normal bucket, but cannot be emptied (to don't change one of main idea of [Hades Revisited.](https://content.luanti.org/packages/Wuzzy/hades_revisited/) subgame)
* hades_xpanes -> Mod xpanes from origin Minetest game mod modified for [Hades Revisited.](https://content.luanti.org/packages/Wuzzy/hades_revisited/) subgame.
* hades_digtron -> [digtron](https://content.luanti.org/packages/FaceDeer/digtron/) mod modified for [Hades Revisited.](https://content.luanti.org/packages/Wuzzy/hades_revisited/).
* hades_moretools ->  [moretools](https://content.luanti.org/packages/SFENCE/moretools/) mod modified for [Hades Revisited.](https://content.luanti.org/packages/Wuzzy/hades_revisited/).

* hades_glass_stained -> Mod [glass_stained](https://content.luanti.org/packages/v-rob/glass_stained/) modified for [Hades Revisited.](https://content.luanti.org/packages/Wuzzy/hades_revisited/).
* hades_animal-> [mobs_animal](https://content.luanti.org/packages/TenPlus1/mobs_animal/) mod modified for [Hades Revisited.](https://content.luanti.org/packages/Wuzzy/hades_revisited/).
* hades_horse -> [mob_horse](https://content.luanti.org/packages/TenPlus1/mob_horse/) mod modified for [Hades Revisited.](https://content.luanti.org/packages/Wuzzy/hades_revisited/).
* hades_extrafarming -> [farming](https://content.luanti.org/packages/TenPlus1/farming/) mod modified for [Hades Revisited.](https://content.luanti.org/packages/Wuzzy/hades_revisited/).
* hades_craftguide2 -> [craftguide](https://forum.minetest.net/viewtopic.php?t=14088&hilit=craftguide) mod modified for [Hades Revisited.](https://content.luanti.org/packages/Wuzzy/hades_revisited/).
* hades_moreblocks -> [moreblocks](https://content.luanti.org/packages/Calinou/moreblocks/) mod modified for [Hades Revisited.](https://content.luanti.org/packages/Wuzzy/hades_revisited/).

* hades_castle_gates -> [castle_gates](https://content.luanti.org/packages/FaceDeer/castle_gates/) mod modified for [Hades Revisited.](https://content.luanti.org/packages/Wuzzy/hades_revisited/).
* hades_castle_lighting -> [castle_lighting](https://content.luanti.org/packages/FaceDeer/castle_lighting/) mod modified for [Hades Revisited.](https://content.luanti.org/packages/Wuzzy/hades_revisited/).

ch.zizka.luanti.mods.awuuwa:awuuwa_building_blocks 39573 发布, various building blocks

This mod contains various bricks mostly at this time, and a few others. There will be more content in the future.

As of now there are no plans for adding crafting recipes to create these nodes in survival, nor do they generate naturally in the world, the mod is intended to be used in a creative world.

More content will be added in the future. This is under active development. I will try to avoid removing nodes from previous versions so that no missing nodes will appear in the world, but that is possible to happen in these early stages of development. Expect the textures and visuals to change over time more or less.
This mod is primarily targeting Minetest Game and Mineclonia / VoxeLibre, but may also work in other games (not tested)

ch.zizka.luanti.mods.YoungChin:coder12_factions_mod_updated 38943 发布, An updated version of Coder12's factions 

github link: https://github.com/YoungerChin/Coder-12s-Factions-Mod-Updated-V1.0.5---Text-Color-and-Commands-/tree/main/Coder12%20Factions%20Mod%20Updated%20V1.0.5

This is an updated version of Coder12's factions mod, fixed to be compatible with the current version of Luanti. This mod was updated using ChatGPT as I am not a coder by trade. 

For those unfamiliar, factions originated in minecraft as a bukkit plugin. It is a gamemode where players will create and join different factions. These factions will then choose to either be allies or compete with eachother for land and resources. 

Features included in this mod:

/f create (name) - Creates a faction with a name chosen by the player

/f claim - Claims land for the faction

/f sethome - Sets a home for the faction

/f home - Teleports a faction member to the faction home (this command was added by me for this updated version of the mod)

/f invite - Invites a player to join your faction

/f leave - Allows a player to leave a faction

A players faction name will be displayed before their username in chat (this was added by me for this updated version of the mod)

/f help - gives a long list of other commands that can be used by players and admins

Link to the original- https://forum.luanti.org/viewtopic.php?t=20949

Update 1.0.1 New Features added:
Safezone- Protected area where players don't take damage and blocks can't be destroyed (good for protecting a spawn area)

Warzone- Same protection as safezone except damage is ENABLED and  fire spreads (good for protecting a PvP arena)

New commands:

/f claim safezone: claims a safezone on the parcel you are standing on (requires admin privs)

/f claim warzone: claims a warzone on the parcel you are standing on (requires admin privs)

/f unclaim safezone: removes a safezone claim on the parcel you are standing on (requires admin privs)

/f unclaim warzone: removes a warzone claim on the parcel you are standing on (requires admin privs)

Players are barred from creating a faction named "safezone" or "warzone" with any combination of capitalizations to prevent Warzone and Safezone claims from being overridden by players.

1.0.2 - Claim Protections Update:

This update changes how faction land claims are protected. Faction land claims are now vulnerable to TNT explosions launched from outside a land claim or put on the border of a land claim. This was done to better facilitate PvP/Raiding. Non-faction members can no longer open doors on faction land claims. There are still objects which are NOT protected and can be opened by non-members: Chests, furnaces, trap doors, fence gates. Non-faction members are still unable to break blocks on a land claim that is not owned by their faction with fists or tools.

1.0.3 - Overclaim Update 
Faction overclaiming has been updated to allow factions with sufficient power to claim territory from enemy factions whose power has fallen below the required threshold. This makes overclaiming function more like the classic CraftBukkit Factions system, where maintaining enough power is essential to protecting your claimed land.

Power loss and regeneration has changed. Faction members now lose 4 power per death and power regenerates by 2 every hour (this can be changed in fac_config/init.lua)

Commands like /f claim, /f sethome, /f unclaim no longer announce coordinates in chat. This helps prevent other players from figuring out where faction claims and bases are located.

Chests placed on faction land claims can no longer be opened by players who are not a part of your faction. Furnaces can still be opened, but items cannot be removed.

1.0.4 - Simple Fixes: 

The time it takes for the mod to display the faction name of the parcel you are standing on has been decreased from 3 seconds to 0.1 seconds.

/f declare_war has been changed to /f enemy. This was done so that command can be typed quickly in the heat of battle.

1.0.5 - Text Color and Commands 
This update changes the color of a faction name in chat based on your relationship to the faction.

member=green ally=purple neutral=white enemy=light red safezone=gold warzone=dark red

Commands regarding diplomacy were shortened to make typing faster and easier (ex: /f send_alliance changed to /f ally) new commands are: /f ally, /f neutral, /f enemy

A console-spamming error about Safezone damage protection being incongruent with Mineclonia's health system has been fixed.

# modutil
A utility mod for minetetest providing useful utilities that can be used in other mods.
Goal of this mod is outsourcing utilities as well as unifying utilities.
Feel free to suggest more utilities that should be added.
Suggestions can be made to make your mods smaller or just if you need help with your own mods.
## features
Some of the utilities are log, translation boilerplate, string operations, etc.
For a full feature and usage list see the [README](https://github.com/theFox6/modutil#modutil).
## latest breaking changes
* The "VenusParser" was renamed to "LuaVenusCompiler"
* The module "log" was renamed to "logging".

ch.zizka.luanti.mods.SilverSandstone:objectuuids 19159 发布, Assigns a persistent UUID to every object.

Object UUIDs
============

This mod assigns a persistent UUID to every player and entity in the game.
Other mods can get an object's UUID or find an object by its UUID using the public API.

UUIDs are persistent between game sessions, and player UUIDs are also
persistent between worlds and servers.

This mod can be safely uninstalled. Entities will lose their UUIDs, but not their data.


API Summary
-----------

- `objectuuids.get_uuid(object)`                                    - Returns the UUID assigned to the specified object.
- `objectuuids.get_object_by_uuid(uuid)`                            - Returns the object with the specified UUID.
- `objectuuids.set_uuid(object, uuid)`                              - Overrides the specified object's UUID.
- `objectuuids.add_entity_with_uuid(pos, name, uuid, [staticdata])` - Spawns a new entity with the specified UUID.

See `doc/index.html` for full API documentation.

ch.zizka.luanti.mods.agent1243:basketball 38990 发布, BasketBall! adds a functional basketball and uses a fork made by me from the TomCon Api.

# BasketBall!
BasketBall! adds a functional basketball and uses a fork made by me from the TomCon Api.

### How to use:
* `Right click` - You can catch the ball, with it in your hand, by pressing the same key you can bounce it off the ground and it comes back to you.
* `Left click Holding on to the ball` - When you hold the ball and press the left button, a bar of strength levels will appear, the greenest point is the weakest, the reddest point is the strongest, and when you release your finger you throw the ball according to the force you applied to it.
* `shift+left click` - Makes you pick up the ball and make it go back in your inventory.

### Coming Soon:
The mod is still in Beta, but I plan to make it much easier to move, I also want to support multiplayer and also craft the basketball

### Acknowledgments:
Thanks to TomCon for creating the Api that with it I made this amazing mod, this mod took months to be made and yes, I had to use AI because luanti has many limitations and also to help me solve bugs easier ;)

ch.zizka.luanti.mods.awuuwa:default_sounds_for_other_games 30591 发布, mods that only depend on "default" for sounds, can be made to use this mod to source the sounds from

If a mod depends on "default" of Minetest Game only to use the default sound effects included in Minetest Game, this mod provides all the default sound effects to be used in any game on the Luanti engine. Meaning, a mod that would otherwise depend on Minetest Game, simply to use it's sound effects, can be now used outside of Minetest Game, in other games. This makes such mods game agnostic. Using this mod assumes that "default" is not installed, and that you are playing some other game than Minetest Game. Don't use this if you are playing Minetest Game, as Minetest Game already comes with all of these sound effects in the included "default" module.

ch.zizka.luanti.mods.orwell:advtrains 36169.1 发布, Adds good-looking, realistic trains with realistic rails.

This mod features realistic trains and various equipment for railways, with a focus on automated train operation.

Main features:

- Almost-realistic tracks with actual curves and switches
- Railway signals, controllable by various means
- ATC: Simple, command-like automatic train control
- LuaATC: Powerful Lua-scripted automatic train operation(requires some programming knowledge)*
- An Interlocking system, featuring track sections, routes and automatic stopping before signals

Please note that the base modpack does not include any trains. Please see the [Train Catalogue](https://advtrains.de/wiki/doku.php?id=usage:trains:start)

[General user manual](https://advtrains.de/manual)

[Guide for the interlocking system](https://advtrains.de/interlocking)

[Wiki](http://advtrains.de/wiki/)

**Distant Signalling Update**

2.5.0 releases the changes from the route_prog_rework branch. This brings the following new features:

* Greatly improved user experience when creating interlocking routes
* More checking and automatic repair of interlocking setups
* Distant signalling support
* New signals: Japanese signals and Munich U-Bahn signals which should replace the old wall signals
* ATC command G waits for green signal ahead

**Please note:**

This version introduces changes to the interlocking save data which are not backwards-compatible. You will not be able to directly downgrade to older advtrains versions again.

For your safety, advtrains saves the last version of the interlocking save file before the upgrade for you. If you want to downgrade advtrains after a world has been started with advtrains 2.5, please observe the following steps:

* Install the older advtrains version
* Open the world directory
* Rename the file "advtrains_interlocking.ls" to "advtrains_interlocking.ls.post250" (you can restore it if something goes wrong)
* Copy "advtrains_interlocking.ls.pre250" to "advtrains_interlocking.ls"
* Start Luanti and load the world

Also note the following:

* You need to enable the new signal mods for them to become visible
* To continue to use Linetrack, if you were previously using Hume2's original version, please update to https://content.luanti.org/packages/Emojiminetest/linetrack/ (thanks Emojiminetest for porting it)

The documentation on the advtrains wiki or the manuals is not updated yet. For an introduction, please see the videos at http://advtrains.de/videos/ for now.
